overview.description: The Grayscale Sui Staking ETF (GSUI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sui, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund designed to provide 100% exposure to the price performance of spot SUI, the native token of the Sui blockchain network, with the potential for additional returns through staking rewards. The percentage of the staked SUI is disclosed on the fund website daily. GSUI was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by Grayscale.
